Weaver

Writers room (long-form narrative state) owned by Weaver

Keeps a manuscript coherent across many writing and revision sessions by treating reader knowledge as derived state with explicit provenance and invalidation: when an earlier scene changes, that scene and every downstream state record go stale and must be re-derived in order. It is a reusable, story-agnostic engine and deliberately contains no Silent Guardian prose, characters, art, audio, or secrets.

← all engines

Pipeline

ground

Assembles the target beat, accepted upstream state, prior closing prose, and anti-reset constraints. A model may propose prose and state; it may not accept derived state, overwrite an immutable release, or publish.

npx weaver grounding <scene-id>
→

accept-state

Explicit operator transition that accepts reviewed derived state through a scene. A model may propose prose and state; it may not accept derived state, overwrite an immutable release, or publish.

npx weaver state:accept
→

quality-gate

Deterministically checks the critical path, repetition policy, and narrative-state freshness. A model may propose prose and state; it may not accept derived state, overwrite an immutable release, or publish.

npx weaver check
→

release

An operator invokes an immutable, content-addressed reader release only after every gate passes. A model may propose prose and state; it may not accept derived state, overwrite an immutable release, or publish.

npx weaver release --id <id>

Ingress → Egress

ConsumesProduces
  • A story-agnostic project contract: outline, world bible, style guide, critical path, and reveal ledger
  • Canonical scene prose plus accepted upstream narrative state
  • An immutable, content-addressed reader release: release.md, release.html, and manifest.json — the only artifact Backlot is allowed to consume
  • Accepted narrative-state snapshots and structured gate results
